review:
Le Bandit reworked as a coin-and-jackpot paylines game. Three or more Coins or Jackpot Markers in any mix pay after regular wins, with coins paying multiples of your bet.

Rainbow and Epic Rainbow symbols trigger two Hold & Win games where coins and jackpots stick and build. Lower ceiling, steadier ride: rated 3/5, 2,500x max, RTP versions from 96.27% down to 86.28%. Good if you prefer hold-and-win to cluster cascades.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
